title: Using Early Readouts to Mediate Featural Bias in Distillation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (DEDIER) for mitigating spurious feature bias during knowledge distillation. While it uses the CivilComments-WILDS dataset which includes religious identity as a category for measuring group fairness, the paper's primary focus is algorithmic debiasing rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or ethics.
